Damn, now I need a book 3. Hear me out on this. SPOILERS! ... and speculation.

Takayanagi uses the name Maki Kanno. Why is she using Maki's name to sell the gold? Presumably that's part of her job. It could be an alias, or she could be Maki's Mom (I'm just gonna call her Ba-chan now)! She survived her fall (because the island's water mutated her and gave her cat-like dexterity). When Maki hears it was her, she goes down and gets Ba-chan. Turns out Ba-chan was wearing old lady makeup and when they take the mask off she's hot. They convince her to join them with Iku's cock... and also by revealing Kana had a boy (the water causes only girls to be born on the island).

Kana has the idea to reform the Island into a high-priced Sex Resort. They'll use the money to build a desalination plant and get their drinking water from the sea. The island water will be available as a high-priced aphrodesiac. Reservations are limited to no longer than one month (drinking the water for less than 6 months is safe). $10,000 gets you a month homestay and you can fuck any woman in the neighborhood. If you want to fuck any woman in the sector it's a higher priced package. You can purchase sex rights to multiple sectors. The ultra-delux package lets you be king of the island for your month. Sectors include: beach (they built a breakwater to calm the currents), mine / shrine (muscely miners and sexy shrine maidens), farm (trad wives and hippies), city center (office ladies, teachers, etc. -- a third of the population is around 20), poor town (lots of skanks), rich town (lots of hot, rich women), senior center (you can't get them pregnant... not that it matters), day care (lots of Mom's killing time while their kids are at school). Return customers can only book once every 2 years.

The Cheif was found and saved by her Daughter Saki (a shrine maiden with the power to possess people and to heal) but she was in a coma briefly. In the meantime, Saki used the Cheif's body and took over as Cheif. She was willing to put Kana's plan into action. She also saved her father and his brother from their fall into the ocean. She's forcing Dad to drink bottled water and shave his leaves. He'll be the security. However, he became sterile from drinking the water for so long. (That's why the generations are so clearly divided. Men only have about 6 months before their body begins to change or they die. After a year, they can still have children but they will have grown in size and started producing flora. After 2 years they will be sterile, so all half-sisters are within 2 years of age. The Generations are: Leaves (Kanna, Saki) 20, Grass (Maki, Cheif) 38, Moss (Takayanagi) 56. Previous generations are Flower, Vine, Eggplant, Cucumber, Zucchini, Mushroom, and if Iku turns, he'll be Dandilion).

All women are allowed to be burried as long as they do at least one tour of duty at the resort. Kurimoto Senpai will do a series of comedy videos on the island where he keeps trying to run from all the sexy women who are hitting on him. Of course when the camera turns off, he takes them up on their offer. That other senpai from chapter 1 shows up to have some fun and help out too. Some of the bit's involve Iku giving them a tour and all the women kissing him while holding their blonde babies. His Senpais always say "unforgivable!" and Iku just says "What can I say, they're really friendly here!" Dad Umetani is also the father of all the 20 year old women Iku had sex with, so he should have complicated feelings towards Iku. After all, he's taken Maki from Dad (though the Cheif probably kept him from her for most of the last 20 years because he's too rough). But he's weak against his daughters and they all love Iku. So maybe a little mild intimidation, and every once in a while a sanity break where he nearly kills Iku, but is reigned in by "shrine maidens" who basically just tempt him with a sexy dance until the Cheif can take care of him. It takes 3 or 4 maidnes to handle his strength.
